description: Ripple changes summary for devbob-acp-multi-vessel-coordination specification

changes.reason: Input validation is self-contained. No other components call this function with dynamic input.
Retry logic is internal to acp_delegate tool. No other tools depend on docker exec spawn behavior.
Version check happens after handshake. No consumers depend on handshake behavior.
Timeout is internal to permission request. No callers affected by timeout behavior.
Added cleanupSession() method. Callers should invoke it, but not required (opt-in).
changes.recommendedUpdate: Update session lifecycle management to call cleanupSession() when sessions close

nonBlockers: Test 2 failure is SurrealDB API content-type issue (test infrastructure, not code)
